description: Schematic markers for nuclei the 437-structure atlas cannot resolve (no VTA, raphe or locus coeruleus meshes). Positions are small offsets from the centroid of an anchor mesh, in model world units — approximate teaching placements only, always rendered with a 'schematic' badge and this explanation.

markers.label: VTA (schematic)
markers.note: Ventral tegmental area lies just medial and slightly superior to the substantia nigra; shown as a marker because no VTA mesh exists.

markers.label: Dorsal raphe (schematic)
markers.note: Dorsal raphe sits on the midline at the midbrain–pons junction, dorsal to the cerebral aqueduct region; approximate marker.

markers.label: Locus coeruleus (schematic)
markers.note: Locus coeruleus is a tiny nucleus in the dorsal rostral pontine tegmentum; approximate marker.
